dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Prominent, high-contrast white horizontal band visible across the greater coverts with sharp grayscale boundaries.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale edges visible on the outer webs of folded primaries and secondaries against dark feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Distinct pale rectangular patch on the posterior neck, bordered by dark head plumage and the upper mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp linear transition from dark head plumage to greenish-grey mantle plumage.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, high-contrast white facial patch extending from the bill base to the nape, bounded by dark plumage on the crown and throat.
